score_attribution.formula: trend_base + paced_volume_bonus + relative_strength_adjustment + futures_adjustment + continuation_aware_obstacle_adjustment + momentum_adjustment + market_breadth_adjustment + extension_guard_adjustment

macro.note: Daily/weekly independent scorer remains context-only; short-term research never overrides swing safeguards.

bull_case.trigger_condition: 4H close above resistance, then retest holds while 12H thesis does not turn bearish
bull_case.invalidation_condition: 4H closes back below structural support or 4H+12H thesis loses bullish alignment

bear_case.trigger_condition: 4H close below support, then failed retest while 12H thesis does not turn bullish
bear_case.invalidation_condition: 4H closes back above structural resistance or 4H+12H thesis loses bearish alignment

htf_scenario_engine.decision_rule: LONG/SHORT remains conditional until its trigger confirms; otherwise WAIT. Opposite 4H/12H evidence cancels the preferred path.
